name: tentacles
desc:
One creature grappled by the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} must succeed on a  DC 13 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute.
Until this poison ends, the target is paralyzed. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
One creature grappled by the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} must make a Constitution saving throw. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
